headline: The fundraising documentation exhibits critical revenue discrepancies and significant gaps in mandatory financial and operational metrics.
key_strengths: Funding ask amount is consistent across pitch deck and financial projections.
Founder ownership data is consistent between the cap table and pitch deck.
key_risks: Revenue figures conflict with no explanation between the pitch deck and audited financial statements (RECON-001).
Cash balance data is missing across all primary documents, preventing assessment of liquidity (RECON-002).
Burn rate and runway metrics are entirely absent from the provided documentation (RECON-003).
EBITDA and margin metrics are missing, preventing profitability analysis (RECON-009).
Reporting periods are inconsistent across documents, complicating point-in-time comparisons (RECON-012).
immediate_actions: Clarify the 33% revenue variance between the pitch deck and audited financial statements (RECON-001).
Provide current cash balance documentation to enable runway and burn rate assessment (RECON-002).
Submit missing burn rate and runway calculations (RECON-003).
Submit missing EBITDA and margin metrics for all reporting periods (RECON-009).
Reconcile reporting period differences across all financial and operational documents (RECON-012).
